method: Ranked by claude-sonnet-5-5, which read 11 of 14 shortlisted pieces

picks.title: AWS Challenger: Trainium3 Inference and Microarchitecture Deep Dive
picks.author: Kimbo Chen
picks.why_it_matters: Cycle-level microbenchmarks of Trainium3 explain why tile-first hardware, DMA descriptor engines and the HBM/cost tradeoff can beat GB300 on inference TCO.

picks.title: Democracy with Cheaply Creatable Minds
picks.author: Beren Millidge
picks.why_it_matters: Cheap copyable minds break the one-person-one-vote assumption; proposes incentive-compatible 'franchise bonds' that make creating voters politically neutral for the creator.

picks.title: Spain’s spectres of civil strife
picks.author: Jason Webster
picks.why_it_matters: Argues Spain's history is a recurring suppression of its own 'other' that keeps resurfacing, from Priscillian's tomb to Santiago Matamoros to the Franco exhumations.

picks.title: Codex Told Me a Secret
picks.author: Tivadar Danka
picks.why_it_matters: A working mathematician gets a likely-novel theorem from a coding agent and asks what authorship and verification duties he owes to a result he only prompted.

picks.title: The Cutthroat Business of Shipwrecks
picks.author: Amelia Soth
picks.why_it_matters: The medieval 'right of wreck' shaped coastal law, architecture and incentives, and enslaved African divers were the hidden labor behind salvage fortunes.
